mapping: Pinned TEI Consortium P4-to-P5 migration applied to the complete single TEI.2 document; retain one TEI root and preserve all source sections and order. Legacy links become P5 ref; entity-backed figures become P5 graphic with original entity identity and provider URL. Invalid legacy page-identifier xml:lang values become ana references; blank page rend values are omitted; language identifiers become ident; TEI.2 header status/type and misplaced publication place move to valid P5 structures. No component splitting or source-text omissions are intended. All 23 retained JPEGs remain supporting authorities, independently hash-bound in source-manifest and source-accountability; the candidate package carries no binary members.

provenance.method: Source-bound DocSouth TEI.2 to P5 single-root conversion with independent Expat oracle and retained-image accounting.
